name: Substance Abuse & Addiction Counseling
summary: Substance Abuse and Addiction Counseling prepares students to help people struggling with alcohol and drug addiction. The major combines psychology, counseling skills, and knowledge of addiction.
description: Addiction Counseling majors study the pharmacology of drugs and alcohol, theories of addiction, assessment and diagnosis, individual and group counseling techniques, case management, relapse prevention, co-occurring mental health disorders, family dynamics, and professional ethics. They also learn about treatment systems and recovery supports. Supervised practicums in treatment centers provide hands-on experience and hours toward state certification as an alcohol and drug counselor. Graduates work in treatment centers, hospitals, prisons, and community agencies.
